systemic_remediation: Each inspected source page must be subdivided into source-first distinct relation/operation/binder/modality atoms BEFORE mapping to SSC; require distinct typed-or-supported dispositions. One shared SSC owner can legitimately cover several atoms; never count page-owner existence as evidence all its source atoms are represented.

source_first_atoms.source_meaning: Positivity of H+P and H-P supplies the stated upper-half-plane holomorphy for two ordered chiral variables z_R,z_L, with C+_R direct-sum C+_L holomorphic translation-semigroup action; not a one-chiral Euclidean real form.
Separate SL(2,R) right/left factors have three upper/lower/real-line orbits; their half-plane action extends to the semigroups SL+(2,C)_R,L, preceding the separate Cayley-to-SU(1,1) compactification.

Woit cites Segal [16] for Diff(S1)_R,L extensions and annulus conformal semigroups A_R,L, with a one-chiral CFT formulated as a representation of A_R on a holomorphic upper S2_R hemisphere with S1_R boundary.

In the one-right-chiral account, the conjugation Theta exchanges S2_R hemispheres, selects an S1_R fixed equator and an SL(2,R)_R Minkowski action, and excludes dependence on the unused left S1_L coordinate; the Euclidean holomorphic half-plane is not an imaginary x_R axis.

Woit attributes to Witten [19] a disk free-chiral-fermion infinite-Grassmannian formulation with no explicit Wick-rotation discussion, and discusses holomorphic principal-bundle coupling as two-dimensional interaction analogy, not a completed 4D construction or imported theorem.

Author contrasts 2D one-form with 4D two-form Hodge chiral splitting and says 4D chiral decomposition concerns complexified rotations, not spacetime; the source distinguishes the opposite-chirality requirement from an additional conventional Hermiticity doubling [11], then proposes a one-chiral holomorphic alternative.

For Phi signature (2,2), PN is the null SU(2,2) projective orbit; compactified Minkowski points correspond to CP1 lines entirely in PN (their light-ray spheres), whereas PN itself is the space of individual light rays and is identified by the source with S3 times S2.
